scripts.pre-db: npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate && npx sequelize db:seed:all
scripts.back-db: npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all
scripts.roll-up-db: npx sequelize-cli db:migrate && npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all
scripts.drop-db: npx sequelize-cli db:drop && npx sequelize-cli db:create && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate && npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all
